meta.title: Compression tiers & toolbox
meta.description: Five-tier context compression plus global rules editing, managed downloads for four components and per-session repository publishing. Tiers switch under Settings → Context compression and apply to every preset engine at once, no restart, with automatic pressure compaction kept on each tier; components are detected on PATH or downloaded under Settings → Components (GitHub CLI, git, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python — resumable, rollback on failure, managed copy first on PATH); the repository selector under the session title decides where github_push publishes. Tools: compression_tiers, compression_context, compression_compact, github_push. It downloads those components from GitHub releases, gyan.dev and python-build-standalone and edits <DSH home>/AGENTS.md atomically; with the plugin off, tiers stop syncing, managed directories leave PATH, and the tools and panels disappear. Limits: tiers assume 256k-token windows or more, and only preset-isolated engines are updated.
